notes.title: World 0 – The Rat Caves
notes.content:
[h2][b]Major Update: World 0 – The Rat Caves[/b][/h2][p]We're excited to release a [b]major update[/b] introducing a brand-new world: [b]World 0 – The Rat Caves[/b]![/p][p]This eerie dungeon-themed world now serves as the [b]new starting point[/b] for all hoarders. Before venturing into the main game, players must now prove themselves by surviving the depths of [b]World 0[/b], a chilling labyrinth crawling with [b]undead rats[/b] and [b]spiders[/b].[/p][p]
[b]What’s New:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]New World Unlocked:[/b] [i]World 0[/i] – a beginner-friendly area designed to ease new players into the mechanics and pacing of the game.
[/p][p][b]New Enemies:[/b] Face off against [b]skeleton rats[/b], and [b]giant spiders[/b] lurking in the shadows.
[/p][p][b]Refined Progression:[/b] World 0 must now be completed to unlock the original first world, giving players a smoother and more immersive onboarding experience.
[/p][p]Whether you're a new player or a returning veteran, [b]World 0 offers fresh gameplay[/b] and a new way to experience the beginning of your journey.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Feedback is always welcome. Thanks for playing![/p][p]— Rogasus[/p]

notes.title: The Undead City Awaits Its Next Champion
notes.content:
The Hardcore World Awaits in the Biggest Update Yet!
Hoarders, the time has come to test your loadouts in the Hardcore World, a brutal new mode introduced in the latest update! Brace yourself for a journey through a nightmarish Undead City, packed with deadly challenges and sinister surprises.

Prepare to face:
[list]
[*]New enemies lurking in every shadow.
[*]New items to aid your survival—or seal your doom.
[*]New bosses that will push your skills to the limit.
[*]New achievements to unlock.
[/list]

Are you ready to conquer the Hardcore World? Sharpen your blades, ready your spells, and dive into the most intense and challenging adventure yet. Challenge your friends and the global community to see who truly reigns supreme in the undead city.

Update your game now and dive into the Hardcore World! The Undead City awaits its next champion. Let the challenge begin!

notes.title: Update 1.3.7
notes.content:
This is the first update after the release!
Here are the changes:

[list]
[*]When leveling, XP shards are required to be at least the same level as the stat 2nd digit. (2 shards for stat 20-29)
[*]More junk-items
[*]Most of the junk-items can now be combined (To make potions or do something silly :)) 
[*]Fullscreen option
[*]"Skullghost"-boss cannot anymore be exploited by filling the inventory before the fight. If no space for cursed skull, it counts as trashing the skull.
[*]"Avoidance" changed to "Stealth"
[*]Typos fixed (resistance, chance)
[*]Minor stat adjustments (Harder Lich boss)
[/list]
Hope you like it :)
